comment: The maker's summary calls this a 7-channel stereo mixer with cutoff; the CUT control is a switch, not a sweep, and puts in a fixed 180Hz first-order high-pass (cutHz at TL_Mixes.cpp:60). The VOL CV multiplies the knob rather than adding to it, so the knob sets a ceiling and the jack sets how much of it is used; with the knob at zero the CV can do nothing. The pan CV replaces the knob outright while patched. On a channel with both inputs connected the pan acts as a balance that attenuates one side, while a channel with only one input connected is panned equal-power across both. The VOL knobs and the MASTER slider both default to zero, which is unusual and makes a fresh module silent. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing is polyphonic. The seven channels are identical in behaviour and share one line per control; their parameter and port indices do run left to right across the panel.
